writer_scope: scratch only; /root is repository sole writer
purpose: Make broader commitments and first-slice preservation obligations reviewable without admitting later implementation.
scope_notes: Foundry family rows and Console workflow rows overlap deliberately: they describe platform capability and consuming product workflow, not additive feature counts.
This is a capability-family ledger, not a complete Foundry leaf inventory or parity claim.
Owning layers identify accountable responsibility, not fabricated employee assignments or authorization to create new crates.
Preservation classifications are design hypotheses requiring review, not migration-free guarantees.
Current source authority and approved design take precedence; source/runtime availability is not implementation admission.
No existing reader, test, migration or historical evidence may be removed to satisfy this ledger.

Dependencies are contract relationships, not an executable dispatch graph. Mutually dependent foundation rows are reviewed together; a cycle does not authorize circular implementation prerequisites or agent fan-out.

gate_definitions.BEFORE_IMPLEMENTATION: Review first-slice preservation constraints and scoped dependencies; approve exact tests and real boundary RED under DELIVERY; no requirement to build later capabilities.
gate_definitions.BEFORE_SLICE_ACCEPTANCE: Execute admitted native first-slice scenarios and observed usability protocol; broader capability evidence stays pending.
gate_definitions.BEFORE_LATER_CAPABILITY_IMPLEMENTATION: Close that capability's exact specification, owner, policy, migration/operational assumptions, tests and independent review/admission.
gate_definitions.BEFORE_PRODUCTION_EXPOSURE: Complete relevant runtime/operational/user evidence and obtain separate exposure, provider and legal authority where applicable.

capabilities.family: Data connectivity, integration, transformation and orchestration
capabilities.phase: LATER_CAPABILITY; internal custody dependency only now
capabilities.accountable_owning_layer: Existing source-domain application/adapter owners; platform integration boundary
capabilities.intended_acceptance_outcome: An admitted connector/transformation produces typed, attributable source revisions with bounded replay, provenance, error and repair behavior.
capabilities.preservation_obligation: Keep native business intent distinct from ingested/source facts; immutable source IDs, schema versions, owner receipts and current authorization; custody is not a shipped ingest product.
capabilities.invalidation_trigger: Import overwrites native truth; new connector bypasses owner; source key or time semantics incompatible with native schema.
capabilities.execution_gate: BEFORE_LATER_CAPABILITY_ACCEPTANCE
capabilities.production_gate: BEFORE_PRODUCTION_EXPOSURE of the capability; separate authority required
capabilities.leaf_owner_status: Owning responsibility identified; exact leaf registration and owner assigned during that capability's design/admission
